name: source-control
description: Git and GitHub delivery workflow: /commit (Conventional Commits + Co-Authored-By trailer via safe heredoc mechanics), /pull-request (prep, create, CI monitoring, review-comment triage, merge, CI-log fetch), /babysit-prs (self-pacing fleet loop — safe by default; opt-in worker/autopilot tiers add gate-checked merge and thread resolution behind a deterministic Python engine), /worktree (create, status, cleanup, audit for parallel-session isolation), /setup (interview the repo and write the tracked commit-subject / PR-title convention config plus babysit-prs userConfig), and /resolve-conflicts (intent-first merge/rebase conflict resolution with a semantic-conflict sweep — never --abort). The commit-subject / PR-title convention is configurable per repo via a tracked .claude/source-control.md config written by a re-runnable setup skill; Conventional Commits is the default when no convention is declared.

watched_owners.title: Watched owners
watched_owners.description: GitHub owners (users/orgs) babysit-prs may act under. Absent: the current repo's owner is inferred per run.

self_logins.title: Self logins
self_logins.description: Your GitHub logins (plus any bot identity you post as). Absent: resolved via `gh api user --jq .login`.

default_tier.title: Default tier
default_tier.description: Tier an explicit bare /source-control:babysit-prs invocation runs: safe, worker, or autopilot. Never applies to auto-routed invocations.

merge_method.title: Merge method
merge_method.description: Merge method for gate-proven merges: merge, squash, or rebase. Absent: repo convention, then squash.

review_trigger_phrase.title: Review trigger phrase
review_trigger_phrase.description: Comment phrase that requests an AI re-review (posted and recognized). Absent: the review-trigger module stays dormant.

review_bot_logins.title: Review bot logins
review_bot_logins.description: Logins of the AI review bots the trigger phrase addresses. Absent: the review-trigger module stays dormant.

review_gate_context.title: Review gate context
review_gate_context.description: Check/status context name of the AI-review gate. Absent: gate treated as absent (degrade).

ci_gateway_context.title: CI gateway context
ci_gateway_context.description: Check/status context name of a CI gateway check. Absent: gateway classification unused.

extra_bot_logins.title: Extra bot logins
extra_bot_logins.description: Additional logins to treat as bots when structural detection cannot identify them. Absent: structural detection only.

approval_downgrade_logins.title: Approval-downgrade reviewer logins
approval_downgrade_logins.description: AI reviewer logins whose APPROVED verdict is downgraded when the review body still carries blocking language. Absent: the downgrade heuristic stays dormant.

skip_downgrade_logins.title: Skip-downgrade reviewer logins
skip_downgrade_logins.description: AI reviewer logins whose skip/no-op review is not treated as an approval. Absent: the downgrade heuristic stays dormant.

max_quiet_recheck_seconds.title: Max quiet recheck seconds
max_quiet_recheck_seconds.description: Longest a quiet PR may go without a worker recheck.

advisory_fix_round_cap.title: Advisory fix-round cap
advisory_fix_round_cap.description: Per-PR cap on advisory-only fix rounds (never caps blocking defects).

worker_concurrency_cap.title: Worker concurrency cap
worker_concurrency_cap.description: Maximum per-PR workers dispatched concurrently in one cycle.

worktree_root.title: Worktree root
worktree_root.description: Root directory for babysit-managed ephemeral worktrees. Absent: the worktrees/ subdirectory of the plugin data dir.
